verdict.rationale: Guidance text from www.uspto.gov pages (apply, patents, fees, timeline) was extracted verbatim, which suggests those pages are readable by a keyless fetch. The site also states that TEAS form previews are available without logging in. However, the developer portal serves a JavaScript app shell, so its API docs are not readable by a plain keyless fetch, and no probe directly records a 200 response with an identified user agent on the main guidance pages. missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML on the guidance pages with an identified UA, readable non-JS developer documentation, and explicit evidence of no CAPTCHA or bot wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: You can preview TEAS forms without logging in on our form previews page.
